_readme: Hand-maintained map for FREEFORM phantom guids that have no reliable anchor
in the boost event itself (episode slugs like 'homegrownhits-100' or
'20250508FH'). The resolver applies these; numeric feed-ids and '<uuid>-<n>'
suffixes are handled automatically and do NOT belong here.
'exact'  maps one raw guid string to the show's real podcast:guid.
'prefix' maps every raw guid starting with 'prefix' to one canonical guid —
use only when a slug family is unambiguously one show. Beware: some
families are ambiguous (e.g. 'homegrownhits-*' spans both the main
Homegrown Hits feed and SXWorldwide), so prefer 'exact' when unsure.
After editing this file, run `resolve-guids` then a FULL D1 reload so the
corrected mapping reaches the website (a delta won't recompute the old rows).
